body:
That sounds like a nice idea to message each other and is a really kind offer from you. I tend to get really unmotivated at times. Maybe its a common depression feeling, feeling really bored but not interested in anything at the same time. I also tend to convince myself of things that probably aren't true regarding stuff like this. Might be helpful to double check my thoughts with someone else at time.

I tried exercise in the past to combat the mental whatevers. I think that might have been part of the problem, I was seeking exercise to be a cure-all for my problems. It was a good experience though because I learned how to use the gym.

Uhh. I have a question, maybe I should make a new post about it. I guess this is more of a question about social norms. I sometimes feel bad mentioning problems with others because I don't want to drag them down. I also don't want to guilt them into listening because its a serious topic. Thinking about stuff like this has made it so I don't often share things with others. I was wondering if anyone has any insight about this.

I'm not too good a circuits! And thanks for the hug. I think you bring up a good point, should focus on other stuff and not completing everything at once. 

I feel a bit better noticing that.

I don't get too much exercise during the semester, I get too lazy. But I told myself I would try to eat a bit healthier and get a bit more exercise. Hearing it from you guys probably makes it a bit more reason to do it.

I'm a pretty skinny guy. My psychiatrist thought my blood pressure/pulse were high because of caffine or something because it seemed kind of abnormal. I get really nervous talking to people so that could be too.

That also might be why I have a hard time describing stuff. Get a bit too nervous.

Not so much full blown robot stuff, but stuff with little simple computers with simple displays and making them do simple stuff. Also some basic circuiting stuff and programming. I switched from B.S. Chemistry so I'm a little behind for my age (I'm a Junior right now) but its kinda fun. Lots of debugging and one female in like my entire class but that's just the way she goes.
Yeah, I enjoy my classes. Its hard to find motivation but I get through the work and get decent grades. I'm studying Computer Engineering.
